# butterchurn-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4+ server: MilkDrop-style audio-reactive WebGL visualizer via butterchurn. Dual transport: **stdio** default, **HTTP** with MCP at `/mcp`. Full-screen Vite dashboard on **10879** proxies to API on **10878**.

**Full detail:** see `llms-full.txt`.

## Quick links
- [README](README.md) — install, run
- [glama.json](glama.json) — Glama discovery

## Ports (fleet range 10700–11500)

| Role | Port |
|------|------|
| FastAPI + MCP HTTP | **10878** |
| Vite dev (SPA) | **10879** |

Adjacency: backend/frontend paired per fleet WEBAPP_STANDARDS.
